A_procedure_and_surface_coverage.supported: All 16 records have one case each with a valid action input, a schema-negative input, an observable state/result, cleanup, member/admin intended modes, required-permission checks, and an owned disposable-window fixture. The action names, valid and invalid input shapes, and stated results match the current local Zod handlers. The fixtures use unique example.com query markers and target owned tab/group IDs. Guest is correctly marked inapplicable for the signed-in Tools use case.

findings.finding: The modes array names member and admin, but it does not establish actual agent-call availability for either role. The current local catalog marks these entries admin_only=false and bundles them for Pilot surfaces; local source cannot prove live tool.binding advertisement or its role gates. Inventory live_binding remains null and source-listed-pending-reconciliation. The manual Tools Run path directly invokes the handler with permissionMode act, so it does not exercise dispatcher Ask/Act confirmation or prove the dispatched tool is available to those roles.
evidence: types/tool-catalog.json: all 16 entries have admin_only=false and surface_bundles pilot/pilot+privileged
src/features/tools/ToolsView.tsx: manual Run validates argsSchema then directly calls handler.run
src/lib/tools/dispatch.ts: action calls use the dispatcher confirmation branch in Ask mode
docs/stabilization/inventory.json: each target retains live_binding=null and source-listed-pending-reconciliation
findings.limit: No database read was authorized or performed; actual live binding and role availability remain unverified.

findings.finding: Valid cases do not exercise every declared input form or optional field: open_new_tab omits optional window_id and index; close_tab uses the scalar tab_ids form only, not the array form; reload_tab uses explicit tab_id with bypass_cache=true, not its omitted-tab assignment fallback/default; move_tab omits destination window_id; create_tab_group omits window_id. The procedures cover the main control behavior but should not be treated as exhaustive schema-field coverage.
findings.evidence: Current Zod schemas in src/lib/tools/handlers/tabs.ts and matching input_schema properties in types/tool-catalog.json.

findings.targets: EXT-F-4071 through EXT-F-4086; especially multi-tab setup in 4073, 4078, 4079, 4081, 4083–4086
findings.finding: The shared precondition says to pass window_id:$WINDOW_ID on every later setup tab, but the per-case open_new_tab examples omit that field and the procedures do not consistently say to check each returned window_id. The broad instruction is present, but the concrete setup recipes can be followed without enforcing the intended same-window fixture invariant.
findings.evidence: Target procedure preconditions and case-specific setup recipes in docs/stabilization/inventory.json; open_new_tab supports window_id and returns window_id in src/lib/tools/handlers/tabs.ts.

findings.finding: Each case requires a second disposable tab to remain active to distinguish explicit-tab targeting, but the setup does not give a concrete action to create that second tab. The main history fixture is otherwise reproducible.
findings.evidence: Case setup preconditions for EXT-F-4078-T01 and EXT-F-4079-T01.

A_procedure_and_surface_coverage.runtime_outcome: No case was run; every test_status remains preserved-unverified and procedure design_status is procedure-ready-unverified.

evidence: Every case requires a fresh hosted TEST resource permit and a completed run journal; local pnpm dev, local build, and local browser execution are prohibited when admission is refused.
Every case requires a current build receipt and the proper reload sequence, including reopening the side panel and reloading fixture tabs; HMR alone is explicitly insufficient.

The manual-run procedures explicitly exclude dispatcher Ask/Act and missing-permission refusal from their coverage. Inventory readiness_gaps preserve these as unresolved, and results remain unverified.
The inventory continues to leave actual tool.binding availability unresolved and preserves source-reconciliation status. The procedures make no product-health or successful-runtime claim.
Required tabs/tabGroups permissions match wxt.config.ts and the local catalog; the group procedures accurately identify Chrome-specific APIs.
